newsitem.title: USA: Standard Financial Q1 shr $0.26 vs $0.31.
newsitem.headline: Standard Financial Q1 shr $0.26 vs $0.31.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTES: In Q1 1996 the company had gains on sales of securities of $1.6 million, but in Q1 1997 the company had a loss on sales of secuities of $100,000. Additionally, in Q1 1996 the company incurred non-recurring legal expenses involved with its successful litigation against LaSalle/Kross Partners LP and investment banking fees of $900,000.
Q1 1997 net interest income was $16.3 million, compared to $15.2 million in Q1 1996. Net interest margin in Q1 1997 was 2.82 percent, versus 2.74 percent Q4 1996 and 3.11 percent in Q1 1996.
Standard Financial Inc is the holding company for Standard Federal Savings Bank.
